findings.title: T100060-08 admission gate test is fudged and duplicates T100060-09 cross-bank check
findings.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/ingest_leaf_tests.rs:235-275: t08_cannot_skip_gates() only tests bank_guard (item.bank_id != ctx.bank), and t09_cross_bank_rejected() merely delegates to t08_cannot_skip_gates(). Neither test exercises admission gate rejection (e.g. invalid category or score below admission threshold) to verify unadmitted canonical units are omitted from LeafIndex.
findings.recommendation: Add a negative admission test for T100060-08 where a candidate unit fails admission policy scoring or category gating, asserting admitted is empty, write is not called, and no item is published to LeafIndex.

resolution.how: Replaced the fudged t08 with a genuine negative admission test and decoupled t09. Both now live in crates/clio-write/src/ingest_gate_tests.rs (moved to keep ingest_leaf_tests.rs under the 450-line limit; declared in ingest.rs). t08_rejected_by_admission_gate uses a grounded, span-verified candidate plus a MirrorNeighbors source (novelty = 0) and theta_admit pinned at 1.0, then asserts: write was not called, out.admitted is empty, out.leaf_queryable is false, LeafIndex::list_leaves is empty, and an `admit_reject` event was recorded. t09_cross_bank_rejected now has its own body (cross-bank item_base vs ctx) asserting InvalidArgument, no write, and no leaf in either bank.
resolution.evidence: cargo test -p clio-write: `ingest::ingest_gate_tests::t08_rejected_by_admission_gate ... ok`, `ingest::ingest_gate_tests::t09_cross_bank_rejected ... ok`; make check PASS.

findings.title: Maintenance hook handoff is synchronous during ingest and untested for non-blocking execution
findings.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/ingest.rs:261 invokes args.maintenance.on_leaf_attached(signal.clone()) synchronously within admit_canonical_units on the write thread. In crates/clio-write/src/ingest_leaf_tests.rs:144-156, run_ingest is passed BufferMaintenance, and SlowMaintenance(200ms) is only invoked manually after run_ingest has returned, masking the fact that a slow hook passed to parallel_ingest would block the write path.
findings.recommendation: Ensure parallel_ingest provides non-blocking maintenance handoff or explicitly specify the buffer/async contract for MaintenanceHook, and add a test verifying that parallel_ingest latency is unaffected by a slow maintenance hook.

resolution.how: Made the handoff explicitly non-blocking and documented the contract. `MaintenanceHook` docs now state the write path MUST NOT wait on the hook and implementors MUST be Send + Sync. Added `SharedMaintenanceHook = Arc<dyn MaintenanceHook + Send + Sync>` and `maintenance::dispatch_async`, which delivers a batch of leaf-attached signals on a detached thread (no thread spawned for an empty batch). Removed the synchronous `on_leaf_attached` call on the write thread (was ingest.rs:266); `parallel_ingest` now calls `dispatch_async` after admit and returns without waiting. `ParallelIngestArgs.maintenance` is now `SharedMaintenanceHook`; exported from lib.rs. New t05_t06_leaf_readable_before_slow_maintenance uses a BlockingMaintenance hook that blocks inside on_leaf_attached until the test releases it (with a 5s watchdog so a regression cannot hang the suite); it asserts ingest returned while the hook is still blocked (no signals recorded), leaf get succeeds in <50ms, then releases and confirms the signal is eventually delivered.
resolution.evidence: cargo test -p clio-write: `ingest::ingest_leaf_tests::t05_t06_leaf_readable_before_slow_maintenance ... ok`; make check PASS.

findings.title: WriteIngestConfig::for_profile does not configure profile-specific parameters
findings.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/ingest.rs:70-75: WriteIngestConfig::for_profile merely assigns profile_label and reuses default settings (concurrency: 4, max_turns: 2). In crates/clio-write/src/ingest_leaf_tests.rs:173-190, testing profiles A, B, C, and reference executes identical configs.
findings.requirement_ref: roadmap/phase-100060.md §12 (NFR-2 timing harness Profile A/B/C config switches)
findings.recommendation: Configure distinct profile parameters in for_profile (or accept runtime profile configs) so that concurrency and chunk limits reflect the Profile A/B/C deployment specifications.

resolution.how: WriteIngestConfig::for_profile now derives concurrency from the deployment profile vCPU budget in hardware.md: A / api-inference -> 1, B / local-retrieval -> 2, C / local-rft -> 4, unknown -> DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY (4). profile_label is preserved and the mapping is documented on for_profile. Added test profile_configs_are_distinct in ingest_tests.rs asserting the distinct concurrency values, the unknown-label fallback, and label preservation.
resolution.evidence: cargo test -p clio-write: `ingest::ingest_tests::profile_configs_are_distinct ... ok`; make check PASS; t06b NFR-2 harness still passes under A/B/C/reference.

findings.title: Post-merge span re-verification is unreachable dead code
findings.evidence: crates/clio-write/src/consolidate.rs:186-201: merge_into retains the first candidate's snapshot unmodified. Consequently, reverify_if_needed in crates/clio-write/src/ingest.rs:207-220 never inspects a modified snapshot, and the false branch at line 232 is never reached or tested.
findings.recommendation: Either implement snapshot reconciliation across merged candidates and test re-verification failures, or remove the dead re-verification branch and document that snapshots are immutable from the initial candidate.

resolution.how: Removed the dead `reverify_if_needed` helper and its never-taken skip branch from ingest.rs. Documented the invariant instead: because consolidation only merges identical-fingerprint or same-key/same-object units, the first contributing candidate's snapshot is canonical and merge never rewrites it (only provenance and source text are unioned). Post-merge span verification is therefore not a separate branch; gated_store_verified re-runs verify_snapshot against the merged source before commit, so every admitted snapshot stays grounded. Updated the CanonicalUnit.snapshot doc and the T100060-07 test comment; removed the now-unused verify_snapshot import.
resolution.evidence: make coverage PASS: clio-write/src/ingest.rs 99.45% lines / 100% functions, consolidate.rs 95.07% lines / 100% functions; no dead branch remains; t07_merged_snapshot_reverify PASS.
